description: Homes listed for sale by owner (FSBO) on ForSaleByOwner.com for a US city: the first 20 listings with address, ZIP, coordinates, asking price (USD), property type, the owner's description (beds, baths, size and features as written by the seller), photo and listing link, plus the total number of FSBO listings in the city. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
